features.title: Parsing a nested binary expression must not corrupt a later tokenize
features.acceptance_test: cd compiler/self-host && ../target/release/kryos.exe run known_failure_nested_binop.kry | tail -1 | grep -q 'after parse: 31 tokens'

features.title: stage1_mini_parser.kry runs to completion with 0 double-frees
features.acceptance_test: cd compiler/self-host && ../target/release/kryos.exe run stage1_mini_parser.kry | tail -1 | grep -q 'stage 1 mini-parser: ok'

features.title: Cranelift must not share one box for a loop-local aggregate captured by spawn
features.acceptance_test: compiler/target/release/kryos.exe run tests/known_failures/spawn_loop_capture.kry -- expect four distinct values, not 30 30 30 30

features.title: Passing a struct with heap fields across a call boundary must not leak (~86MB/1M)
features.acceptance_test: tests/mem/struct_arg_leak.kry -- heap_field_method peak RSS must not scale with iteration count (compare 250k vs 1M, repeat each 3x)

features.title: comptime{} runs at runtime while docs sell compile-time -- correct the docs
features.acceptance_test: docs no longer claim compile-time evaluation guarantees for comptime{}

features.title: [dyn Handler] should report E0110, not a confusing E0100
features.acceptance_test: a program with `let hs: [dyn Handler] = [A{}, B{}]` reports E0110
